sources.title: bert-mini | PromptLayer Models
sources.snippet: What is bert-mini? BERT-mini is a compact variant of the BERT architecture designed for efficient pre-training and downstream task performance. Developed as part of research on compact language models, it represents a balance between model size and capability, featuring 4 layers and 256 hidden units.
